name: Architecture Review (IRCC)
tagline: Finds inconsistencies across design documents · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Reviews the design documents you supply for contradictions between them, departures from standards and ADRs, and decisions still open. It returns a cited review report and a deviation log for the lead architect.
starters: Review the attached FDD and TDD for inconsistencies
Do the attached designs follow our security standards?
List open decisions in the attached designs
attachHint: Attach the design documents to review (.md, .txt, .docx, .pdf or OpenAPI .yaml).
